cards.label: Great Exhibition Opens in London
cards.tooltip: The first world’s fair draws over six million visitors to Hyde Park, showcasing industrial achievements from around the globe.

cards.label: Florence Nightingale radically re-organizes battlefield hospitals, pioneers modern nursing
cards.tooltip: Florence Nightingale radically re-organizes battlefield hospitals, pioneers modern nursing.

cards.label: Darwin’s theory of evolution by natural selection overturns centuries of thinking about life on Earth
cards.tooltip: Charles Darwin’s theory of evolution by natural selection overturns centuries of thinking about life on Earth.

cards.label: First Feature Film Premieres in Paris
cards.tooltip: Auguste and Louis Lumière screen “La Sortie de l’Usine,” marking cinema’s birth as mass entertainment.

cards.label: First Powered Flight by Wright Brothers
cards.tooltip: Orville and Wilbur Wright complete the first controlled, sustained powered flight, launching the aviation age.

cards.label: First Nonstop Transatlantic Flight Completed
cards.tooltip: John Alcock and Arthur Brown fly nonstop from Newfoundland to Ireland, proving long-distance air travel.

cards.label: First 'Talkie' Premieres: The Jazz Singer
cards.tooltip: Al Jolson stars in The Jazz Singer, ushering in synchronized sound and revolutionizing cinema.

cards.label: First Drive-In Movie Theater Opens
cards.tooltip: Richard Hollingshead’s drive-in in New Jersey introduces a novel way to watch films from your car.

cards.label: Z3: World’s First Working Programmable Computer
cards.tooltip: Konrad Zuse’s Z3 uses binary arithmetic and punched tape, pioneering modern computing concepts.

cards.label: First Controlled Nuclear Chain Reaction Achieved
cards.tooltip: Enrico Fermi’s Chicago Pile-1 demonstrates a sustained nuclear chain reaction, starting the atomic age.

cards.label: Nuclear Bomb Used in Warfare for First Time
cards.tooltip: The U.S. detonates atomic bombs over Hiroshima and Nagasaki, hastening World War II’s end.

cards.label: Polaroid Introduces Instant Camera
cards.tooltip: Edwin Land’s camera produces developed photos in under a minute, revolutionizing photography.

cards.label: First Privately Funded Spaceplane Flies
cards.tooltip: SpaceShipOne completes the first privately funded human spaceflight, inspiring a new commercial space industry.

cards.label: First YouTube Video Uploaded
cards.tooltip: 'Me at the zoo' becomes the first clip on YouTube, kickstarting the world's largest video-sharing platform.

cards.label: First Tweet Sent on Twitter
cards.tooltip: Jack Dorsey's 'just setting up my twttr' marks the birth of real-time microblogging.

cards.label: First iPhone Launches
cards.tooltip: Apple's touchscreen smartphone redefines mobile devices, blending phone, iPod, and internet communications.

cards.label: First 3D-Printed Car Revealed
cards.tooltip: Local Motors unveils the Strati, the first vehicle with major components 3D-printed, hinting at future manufacturing breakthroughs.

cards.label: First Direct Gravitational Waves Detected
cards.tooltip: LIGO observes ripples in spacetime from colliding black holes, confirming a century-old prediction of general relativity.

cards.label: First Autonomous Vehicle Fatality Occurs
cards.tooltip: An Uber self-driving car strikes and kills a pedestrian, prompting global scrutiny of autonomous vehicle safety.

cards.label: First Female U.S. Vice President
cards.tooltip: Kamala Harris becomes the first woman and first woman of color to serve as vice president, breaking a historic glass ceiling.

cards.label: First AI Chatbot Passes U.S. Bar Exam
cards.tooltip: An AI model scores high enough to pass portions of the bar exam, raising questions about law practice and AI's role.

cards.label: First Human Orbits Earth
cards.tooltip: Yuri Gagarin becomes the first person in space, marking a milestone in the Space Race.

cards.label: First Super Bowl Is Played
cards.tooltip: The inaugural championship between NFL and AFL champions laid the foundation for a major American sports tradition.

cards.label: Woodstock Festival Defines a Generation
cards.tooltip: A three-day music festival drawing half a million attendees embodied the counterculture ethos of peace and music.

cards.label: First Test-Tube Baby Is Born
cards.tooltip: Louise Brown’s birth via in vitro fertilization paved the way for modern assisted reproductive technologies.

cards.label: First Space Shuttle Flight Takes Off
cards.tooltip: Columbia inaugurates reusable spacecraft missions, revolutionizing human spaceflight.

cards.label: Nelson Mandela Becomes First Black President of South Africa
cards.tooltip: After 27 years in prison, Nelson Mandela’s election signaled the end of apartheid and the birth of a multiracial democracy.

cards.label: First Permanent Crew Occupies ISS
cards.tooltip: Expedition 1 crew begins continuous human presence on the International Space Station, marking a new era of orbital habitation.
